title: ALMA Observations of Young Eruptive Stars: Continuum Disk Sizes and Molecular Outflows
question: How do disk sizes, masses and molecular outflows of FUor/EXor eruptive young stars compare with non-eruptive Class 0/I and Class II disks, and what does this imply for their evolutionary stage?
